notes.title: Dreamwalker Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Just a small patch mostly to fix some minor issues, but also added a tiny bit of content.


Updated the engine
Fixed some typos
Fixed a small issue with plot logic
Fixed a bug where the game would show you being in a call with Henry after the call was ended
Added a new background image for cabin interior
Added some more dialogue explaining things to the conversation when [spoiler]you meet Yukiko in real life[/spoiler]. This is the biggest addition in this patch
Added some new dialogue lines to [spoiler]Sonya's romance event[/spoiler]
Modified a few existing dialogue lines to better convey the intended tone
Added a new (very) small scene

notes.title: A new game, "Shadows of Betrayal", in the works
notes.content:
Hi,

Sorry for the lack of updates on Dreamwalker. As far as I know though, no bugs have been found so there hasn't been a reason to fix anything. 🙂

Instead, inspiration struck, and I have focused my efforts on a completely new game: Shadows of Betrayal.

It is another visual novel, and the gameplay is very similar to that of Dreamwalker, but the story itself and the look of the game is very different. This time I'm using 3D-models that I created myself for the characters, so I'm able to add animations and as many different expressions as I want to. I think I've really leveled up the graphics with this one.

Considering the story, I've said that this game is like an edgier younger brother of Dreamwalker. Shadows of Betrayal is a story about a group of teenagers, recent high school graduates, who go on a trip to a remote cabin in the middle of nowhere. This won't be just a typical teen gathering though, for there's something sinister in the air of those beautiful summer days.

If you liked Dreamwalker, or if you like these type of games in general, check out my new trailer for Shadows of Betrayal! And please wishlist the game if it seems like something you think you'd enjoy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871350/Shadows_of_Betrayal/

Thanks for your time and your interest in my humble game productions,

- JayzonBH

notes.title: Dreamwalker now out!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Dreamwalker is finally out and I am happy and relieved to be able to share my little story with you all. Hopefully you will have a great time with what I have created. I will continue polishing the game still in the future, but rest assured that the story is complete, and there are no issues that I'm aware of. If you find any, please tell me so I can get them fixed.

If there seems to be enough demand, there might also be some free content updates coming in the future in the form of side stories. These would happen in the same world but have a new protagonist. Some characters from the base game might make an appearance! There is a tiny sample of one side story in the game already for those who have reached the good ending, to give you an idea what to expect.

Don't expect these side stories soon though, since I'm just going to chill a bit for now, and play some games myself. 😁

Thank you so much for supporting Dreamwalker! 

- JayzonBH
